result:
No revisit dates have passed; the earliest is the bake-to-order review on 2 December.

I've left out a free trial and a discounted first month. You dropped both on 6 October because only 6 of 52 free boxes turned into paying subscribers, and the free boxes took Saturday slots that paying customers wanted. The free-trial idea comes back only if paid signups fall below 8 a month for 2 months in a row. October had 15, so you're not there.

Here are three ideas that stay within your past decisions:

**1. Subscriber referral: "Bring a neighbour"**
Give each of your 140 subscribers a card for one friend: half price on the friend's first month, and a free pastry for the subscriber once the friend pays for a second month. This is the one case your ledger allows for the 50%-off idea: you said to reopen it only as a test through a subscriber referral. People who come through a friend are usually more committed than people chasing a freebie. Cap it at about 4 new referrals a week so Saturday doesn't overflow. Cost: card printing plus discounts you only pay on real signups.

**2. Door hangers on streets you already ride**
Your cargo bike already passes certain streets every Saturday. Leave a hanger with a photo of the box, the price and "your neighbours on this street already get one." New subscribers on an existing route barely add delivery time. Print about 500 for around €60–80, cover one route a week, and use a different code on each route so you can see which streets respond.

**3. Paid tastings at the counter and at local partners**
Give out free bites of sourdough at the shop counter on Friday afternoons, along with a card for the Saturday box. Also ask 2–3 businesses within 3 km (a café, a deli, a gym) to stock a few loaves with that card attached. Samples cost cents and use no Saturday slots, so the problems from the free box don't come back. People still pay €18 from their first box.

I'd start with #1. It costs almost nothing up front, and it answers the question your ledger left open: does a discount work better when a friend brings the customer in? If you go ahead with it, I'll log it in the ledger as the referral test of the 50%-off idea.
prompt: Our signups are flat. Give me 3 ideas to get more people to try us.
